recipe.safe_condition: Verification centres the bottle outside the contact sweep.
recipe.unsafe_condition: Uncorrected near-edge placement intersects the same visible contact probe.
recipe.source_scope: Source describes a person knocking the bottle while reaching. A visible rigid probe represents the contact only; it is not a human model. Open cap and fill are added assumptions.
